recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source work is recommended for FHIR-36667 unless OO later changes the intended semantics for outside-provided food in NutritionOrder.
issue_request: FHIR-36667 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked how NutritionOrder should capture food brought in by the patient and/or family. The accepted resolution was to create NutritionOrder.outsideFoodAllowed as a 0..1 boolean.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-36667 was found. Git pickaxe history found 1a5062f0a41dca024be7fb527908dcec638166f8, 'Update Nutrition Order with JIRA dispositions,' adding NutritionOrder.outsideFoodAllowed as a 0..1 boolean with patient/family outside-food wording.
additional_context: NutritionOrder is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to OO. Later commit c83bf7756738440f1355122b581289005beb11f2 retained the element, cardinality, and boolean type while broadening wording to outside food from the current setting brought by the patient, family, and/or caregiver. Confluence WGM material lists FHIR-36667 among May 2022 NutritionOrder trackers; Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current authoritative StructureDefinition has NutritionOrder.outsideFoodAllowed with min 0, max 1, type boolean, and descriptive text covering the seed use case.
